scientific_integrity: The all-size proof uses explicit flow certificates and corner attainment; exact rational finite tests are supplemental, not an infinite proof. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real nearest-neighbor rectangles with both side lengths at least two, free boundary, unit graph edge weights and uniform means separately over parity classes. Nonuniform weights and nonrectangular grids are not covered. Historical priority is subject to incomplete indexing.
title: Sharp checkerboard-averaging variation gain on every rectangular grid
